body: Did I say “in this sample” when appropriate?
Did I separate observed data from a proposed explanation?
Does my certainty match the design and uncertainty?
Did I infer individual ability from a group average?
Why would evidence from reviews apply to admissions?
Did I name costs, fairness and a testable pilot?
Are empirical evidence / in line with / at the expense of used correctly?
The evidence suggests ___; however, ___ remains uncertain. I would revise my position if ___.
